asj-baidu-1.webp.zh: 航站楼前的机坪：旅客拎着行李走向写着「AMAMI」的大楼，地勤人员在一旁引导。
asj-baidu-1.webp.en: On the apron before the terminal — passengers with luggage heading for the building marked 'AMAMI', ground staff directing them.

asj-baidu-2.webp.zh: 登机桥旁的日本航空通勤（JAC）客机：两架支线客机同时停靠，机场紧邻海岸线。
asj-baidu-2.webp.en: Japan Air Commuter aircraft at the stands — two regional jets boarding beneath the signs, the sea just beyond the runway.

asj-baidu-3.webp.zh: 从空中眺望奄美机场：跑道沿海岸线铺展，海水与珊瑚礁在机翼下清晰可见。
asj-baidu-3.webp.en: Amami from the air — the runway strung along the coast, reef-flecked water stretching below.
